purpose: How things work: discounts, how payments and quotes behave and other settings that affect the whole team.
tips: They affect every user: change them with the team in the loop.

config.clinic-prefs.section.discounts.label: Discounts
config.clinic-prefs.section.discounts.description: Enables discounts on quotes and invoices, capped by percentage or amount.

config.clinic-prefs.section.identity-doc.label: ID document
config.clinic-prefs.section.identity-doc.description: Whether it's required when registering patients.

config.clinic-prefs.section.duplicate-co.label: Duplicate contacts
config.clinic-prefs.section.duplicate-co.description: Whether the same phone or email is allowed on two patients (families). Affects WhatsApp and the portal.

config.clinic-prefs.section.alert-email.label: Alert emails
config.clinic-prefs.section.alert-email.description: Whether alerts send their email to the patient on their own.

config.clinic-prefs.section.assistant.label: Guided assistant
config.clinic-prefs.section.assistant.description: Mascot visible or only the help icon.

config.clinic-prefs.section.schedule-exp.label: Export calendar to Excel
config.clinic-prefs.section.schedule-exp.description: Format of the Excel file downloaded from the calendar: basic or extended.

config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.label: Basic
config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.description: One calendar per file: Time, Full name and Phone, with a row showing the date before each day. This is the default format.

config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.label: Extended
config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.description: Several calendars and branches at once, with the chosen columns and filters on the header; optionally, one sheet per branch.

config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.label: One sheet per branch
config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.description: Extended only: each branch on its own sheet, named after it; the Branch column is left out. Branches with no appointments get no sheet.

config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.label: Excel columns
config.clinic-prefs.field.schedule_expor.description: Extended only: which columns are included (branch, calendar, date, time, end, patient, phone, email, doctor, service, status, notes) and in what order.

config.clinic-prefs.field.identity_docum.label: Require ID document
config.clinic-prefs.field.identity_docum.description: The patient record can't be saved without a document.

config.clinic-prefs.field.identity_docum.label: Require it to change an appointment's status
config.clinic-prefs.field.identity_docum.description: The appointment can't move to the chosen statuses if the patient has no document; cancelling is never blocked.

config.clinic-prefs.field.identity_docum.label: Statuses that require the document
config.clinic-prefs.field.identity_docum.description: Which statuses ask for it (Completed by default).
